findings.title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities (theft of ethers)
findings.description:
Reentrancy in Bank.withdraw() (Bank.sol#6-11):
	External calls:
	- (ok,None) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}() (Bank.sol#8)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] = 0 (Bank.sol#10)
	Bank.balances (Bank.sol#4) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- Bank.balances (Bank.sol#4)
	- Bank.deposit() (Bank.sol#5)
	- Bank.withdraw() (Bank.sol#6-11)
findings.markdown:
Reentrancy in [Bank.withdraw()](Bank.sol#L6-L11):
	External calls:
	- [(ok,None) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}()](Bank.sol#L8)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- [balances[msg.sender] = 0](Bank.sol#L10)
	[Bank.balances](Bank.sol#L4) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- [Bank.balances](Bank.sol#L4)
	- [Bank.deposit()](Bank.sol#L5)
	- [Bank.withdraw()](Bank.sol#L6-L11)
